{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor
|gr2= Event Handlers

|descr= Removes Eden Editor event handler of given type and ID.
<br><br>
See the list of all [[Arma_3:_Event_Handlers:_Eden_Editor|Eden Editor Event Handlers]].

|s1= [[remove3DENEventHandler]] [type,id]

|p1= type: [[String]] - name of event handler
|p2= id: [[Number]] - ID of event handler, returned by [[add3DENEventHandler]]
|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
eh = add3DENEventHandler ["onUndo",{systemChat "Zip..."}];
remove3DENEventHandler ["onUndo",eh];
</sqf>

|seealso= 
[[add3DENEventHandler]]
[[removeAll3DENEventHandlers]]
}}
